statBlock.name: Feyr
statBlock.description: A hovering tentacled horror that feeds on strong emotions. It avoids confrontation by hiding aboard spelljamming ships and feeding on the nightmares of sleeping crew.

sections.Traits: Unusual Nature. The feyr has no need to breathe.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Frightful Bite attack and one Tentacle attack.
Frightful Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Deal 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage on a hit. After the hit, every creature within 10 ft. that can see the feyr must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened of it until the end of the feyr's next turn.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. On a hit, the target takes 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage and is grappled (escape DC 13). Each of the feyr's two tentacles can hold one creature and cannot attack a different target while holding one.
Invisibility. The feyr turns invisible. An attack or use of Nightmare Fuel ends the effect. It can also end it as a bonus action.
Nightmare Fuel (1/day). Choose an unconscious creature the feyr can see within 10 ft. The target must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or take 27 (5d10) psychic damage. The feyr gains as many temporary hit points as the damage it actually deals.

statBlock.name: Gaj
statBlock.description: A six-legged ambush predator that buries itself in loose ground or waits on dark stone ledges. It interrogates captured prey by wrapping its antennae around the victim’s head.

sections.Languages: Understands all languages and cannot speak.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Mandibles attack and use Mind-Probing Antennae or, if recharged, Paralyze.
Mandibles. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. On a hit, the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage and is grappled (escape DC 11). The target takes another 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage at the start of each of the gaj's turns while held. The gaj can attack only the held creature with its mandibles until that grapple ends.
Mind-Probing Antennae. One creature grappled by the gaj makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage and the gaj magically learns one piece of information it seeks from the creature's mind. On a success, it takes half damage and reveals nothing.
Paralyze (Recharge 6). The gaj magically targets one creature it can see within 60 ft. The target must pass a DC 12 Wisdom save or become paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

statBlock.name: Giff Shipmate
statBlock.description: A disciplined sailor who makes up the rank and file on a giff spelljamming vessel.

sections.Traits:
Firearms Knowledge. The giff ignores the loading property on any firearm.
Steady as She Goes. On a ship’s deck, the giff has advantage on ability checks and saving throws against being knocked prone or shoved overboard.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with the Longsword or Musket.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage on a hit, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage when wielded with two hands.
Musket. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Deal 8 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage on a hit.
Force Grenade. Throw a grenade to a point within 60 ft. Each creature in the 20-ft.-radius sphere makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. It takes 17 (5d6) force damage on a failure or half on a success. Roll a d6 after the throw. On a 1–4, the giff is out of grenades.

statBlock.name: Giff Shock Trooper
statBlock.description: An armored assault specialist who breaks up defenses with gunfire and follows with a charge.

sections.Traits:
Firearms Knowledge. The giff ignores the loading property on any firearm.
Headfirst Charge. If the giff moves straight for at least 20 ft. and ends within 5 ft. of a Large or smaller creature, that creature must pass a DC 16 Strength save or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and fall prone.
Siege Monster. The giff deals twice its normal damage to structures and objects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with the Greatsword or Musket.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage on a hit.
Musket. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Deal 15 (2d12 + 2) piercing damage on a hit.
Thunder Bomb. Light a bomb and throw it to a point within 60 ft. Every creature in a 10-ft.-radius sphere centered there makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. It takes 18 (4d8) thunder damage on a failure or half on a success. Roll a d6 after throwing it. The giff has no bombs left on a 1–4.

statBlock.name: Giff Warlord
statBlock.description: A mercenary commander who leads a small spelljamming fleet from a fortified base. A giff shock trooper or a hired mage might serve in the warlord's forces.

sections.Traits:
Firearms Knowledge. The giff ignores the loading property on any firearm.
Legendary Resistance (2/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Morningstar attacks.
Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage on a hit.
Double-Barreled Musket. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Deal 28 (4d12 + 2) piercing damage on a hit.
sections.Legendary actions:
The giff has 3 legendary actions and recovers any it has spent at the start of its turn. Use only one option at the end of another creature's turn.
Move (1 action). Move up to the giff's speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Rallying Cry (1 action). End the frightened condition on the giff and on any creatures it chooses that it can see within 30 ft.
Weapon of Choice (2 actions). Make two Morningstar attacks or one Double-Barreled Musket attack.

statBlock.name: Githyanki Buccaneer
statBlock.description: A pirate who raids ships in the Astral Plane and keeps the spoils in a hidden stronghold. Many buccaneers once fought for Vlaakith before leaving her service.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with the Greatsword or Telekinetic Bolt.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage on a hit.
Telekinetic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Deal 13 (3d6 + 3) force damage on a hit.
Spellcasting (Psionics). Use an action to cast one of the spells below without components. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 13).
At will. Light and Mage Hand. The hand is invisible.
1/day each. Plane Shift and Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Astral Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. into an unoccupied space the githyanki can see, taking along anything it wears or carries.

statBlock.name: Githyanki Star Seer
statBlock.description: A spellcaster who questions stellar entities such as Acamar, Caiphon, and Hadar, then commits their answers to journals. Star seers search Wildspace for beings no one has contacted before.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Astral Bolt attacks.
Astral Bolt. Melee or ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Deal 20 (3d10 + 4) radiant damage on a hit.
Spellcasting (Psionics). Use an action to cast one of the spells below without components. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 15).
At will. Light and Mage Hand. The hand is invisible.
2/day each. Detect Magic, Invisibility (self only), Mage Armor (self only), and Tongues.
1/day each. Contact Other Plane (takes one action), Plane Shift, and Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Astral Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. into an unoccupied space the githyanki can see, taking along anything it wears or carries.
